tools.description: Find credit cards open to new applicants by issuer, annual fee, network, rewards currency, or a benefit they carry. Returns a short row per card; call get_card_facts for one card's full record. Card facts only — no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.

benefit.description: Words to look for in a card's statement credits, lounge networks, or purchase/travel protections, e.g. 'Global Entry', 'Priority Pass', 'trip delay'.

has_free_night_certificate.description: Only cards granting a free night certificate.

has_lounge_access.description: Only cards carrying at least one lounge network.

max_annual_fee.description: Highest annual fee in dollars, inclusive.

no_foreign_transaction_fee.description: Only cards with no foreign transaction fee.

rewards_currency.description: Loyalty currency the card earns, e.g. 'Chase Ultimate Rewards'. Matched loosely.

tools.name: search_card_catalog
tools.title: Search the card catalog

tools.description: Everything the public catalog holds on one card: issuer, annual fee, network, foreign transaction fee, rewards currency, and the names of its statement credits, lounge networks and protections. Card name is matched loosely. Card facts only — no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.

card_name.description: Card name, e.g. 'Amex Platinum' or 'Venture X'.

tools.name: get_card_facts
tools.title: One card's catalog record

tools.description: The same catalog record for 2-5 cards at once, for comparing fees, networks and which benefits each carries. Card facts only — no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.
tools.name: compare_card_facts
tools.title: Compare cards side by side

tools.description: Which loyalty programs a currency transfers to, or which currencies reach a destination, and whether a transfer bonus is running. This is the route graph only — it does not carry transfer ratios, bonus sizes, expiry dates, or which route is worth taking. Card facts only — no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.

include_inactive.description: Include routes that have been discontinued.

only_with_bonus.description: Only routes with a transfer bonus running.

to_program.description: Destination program, e.g. 'World of Hyatt'. Matched loosely; call with neither argument to list every source.

tools.name: find_transfer_routes
tools.title: Which transfer routes exist

tools.description: Miles' own estimate of a loyalty point's value in cents, optionally multiplied by a balance. Call with no arguments to list every program Miles values, with the exact spelling to use. These are Miles' estimates, not market prices — attribute them. Card facts only — no earning rates, welcome-offer amounts, transfer ratios, or bonus sizes.

points.description: A balance to value, in points.

program.description: Loyalty program, e.g. 'World of Hyatt'. Matched loosely. Omit to list all.

tools.name: estimate_point_value
tools.title: What a point is worth
